title: Hosted verification: after a managed upgrade declares storage.notNull:false, re-saving without the field is not refused (closes the read owed by #34377 and #33724)
body:
sweep#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYJqoPAoSpWTMpH1yq

Source: maintainer — Warren, 2026-11-19 00:32Z in the objectstack priorities discussion thread: 「可以拆的都同意。」 (the split list's item 1: close #34377 and #33724, file one hosted verification card). Rule: #35259 item 7.

Filing gate: ③ a task the maintainer dispatched. Reader: whoever can sign in to a hosted (staging) environment; no fleet seat can, so this is a maintainer card. Dedupe: open cards naming `relaxInstallDeclaredNotNull` or `storage.notNull:false` on hosted — none besides the two closed in this stroke.

Grade: p2 · area:cloud · Task · the C-section grade Warren approved for the pair (00:27Z 「34377 同意」)

## Why

Both halves are on main and in cloud's pin:
- framework: PR #34408 (`69949aedc1`, the Turso REMOTE face relaxes a NOT NULL column in place), closing #33724's framework half;
- cloud: cloud PR #4753 (`7ae780348`), the hosted kernel rebuild calls `relaxInstallDeclaredNotNull` after schema sync, closing #34377's cloud half.

Cloud's pin `958ee0359496` (objectstack 18.6.0, cloud PR #4867) carries `69949aedc1` (compare: pin is ahead). Nothing is left to build; only a hosted read is owed.

Maintainer-action: on staging (cloud main at or after `0ea8652e4`, the 18.6.0 pin), install a package version whose object declares a field `storage: { notNull: true }`, create a record, upgrade the installation to a version declaring that field `storage: { notNull: false }`, then save a record that leaves the field empty — done when a comment here records the save's answer (pass: saved, no `VALIDATION_` "… is required" refusal) and the environment's build log line for the relax.

## Done when

The reading is on this card. Pass ⇒ close completed. Fail ⇒ the reader files a defect card with the answer and links it here.
